title: grepai: the missing link between your codebase and your AI agent
description:
grep from 1973 finds exact text matches. Your codebase in 2026 needs semantic understanding. grepai indexes your code using vector embeddings so you can search by meaning—"user authentication flow" instead of regex patterns. Built for AI agents so they get better context with fewer searches. Auto-boosting deprioritizes tests and mocks, prioritizes actual source code. Has call graph tracing to find what calls what. Runs as an MCP server so Claude can use it natively.

https://github.com/yoanbernabeu/grepai
